tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal mgon trak+shad kyi chos skor lo rgyus

zin bris su bkod pa bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ spyir sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bka' nyan bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi srung ma dpag tu med pa zhig bzhugs pa/ bstan srung chos skyong thams cad kyi gtso bo phyogs bcu dus gsum kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bka'i srung ma ni/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po lcam dral 'di dag yin la/ de la ye shes kyi mgon po zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam sprul rnam pa yang 'phags pa'i sa la gnas pa yin/ las kyi mgon po dngos ni ye shes kyi mgon po de'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub sla ba'i don du thugs las sprul pa'i mgon po chung ba rnams yin/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po ni dpal mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga lta bu'ang yin/ yang sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig tu las mkhan 'jig rten pa 'ga' zhig las mgon du mi btags pa ni che brjod tsam du zad/ de dag las 'dir dpal ye shes kyi mgon po trak+shad zhes bya ba 'di gsang sngags rnying ma rnams ltar na 'phrin las kyi mgon po trak+shad ces 'byung ba ni las kyi mgon po yin zer ba'i don ma yin/ mgon po 'di nyid mgon chen ye shes kyi mgon po yin zhing*/ gzhan la ma ltos pa'i rkang tshugs yin kyang mngon sbyod gtso bor gyur pa'i phrin las ye shes mgon po gzhan rnams las kyang myur zhing stobs che ba nyid kyi phyir 'phrin las mgon po zhes bya/ yang gcig tu na ye shes kyi mgon po gzhan rnams kyi sgrub pa las sbyor gyis ma 'grub cing lus na/ ye shes kyi mgon po 'di nyid bsten pa'am 'di'i rnam sprul mgon po chung ba mgon po mon par grags pa/ 'di la ra mda' sbron pa'i tshul gyis las bcol byed dgos pa yang shin tu mang ste/ gur gyi mgon po la las mgon zangs gri can dang*/ phyag bzhi pa la las mgon bya rog gdong can yod pa yang 'di'i mgon po mon pa dang gcig la/

phyag drug pa la trak+shad kyi mtshan can rang yang dngos su yod/ dpal chen rga lo'i gsung gi mgon po bya rog mas las grub pa'i 'byams sdug byung na legs ldan bdud kyi rgyal po ra mdar sbron dgos gsungs pa'i bdud kyi rgyal po yang mgon po trak+shad do/ / des mtshon de chos skyong gzhan thams cad la yang 'phrin las rang stobs kyis ma 'grub na mgon po 'di'i dmag dpung phyur ba'i tshul gyis 'phrin las sgrub dgos pas 'phrin las mgon po zhes bya'o/ /chos skyong 'di dang por byung tshul ni/ bskal ba chags nas mi ring ba na'ang lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa'i dus kyi bskal ba la/ lha min rnams kyi khrag sa la 'thor ba lha min brgya stong du mar song ste/ lha min gyi dmag la zad pa med nas lha rnams pham pa las/ ye shes kyi mgon po 'di mahā de ba'i sras su sku sprul te/ lha min thams cad mdung rtse gsum pas bsnun te tshar bcad/ khrag rnams sa la ma 'bab par bar snang nyid la gsol bas lha min 'gribs te lha rgyal par gyur to/ /gzhan yang lha min dang srin po'i grong khyer sum brtsegs lan gsum du bcom pa sogs lha rnams rgyal bas 'jig rten bde bar mdzad do/ /yang phyi'i dus shig na sangs rgyas 'od srung la sogs pa snga ma'i bstan pa la/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje dang 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs bka' bgros te sbyan ras gzigs dbang gi rtsa ba'i mgon po phyag gnyis pa la bka' bsgos/ sde brgyad dregs pa gzhan thams cad bka'i 'bangs su phab/ bran du dbang bskur ba las byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin chen po brgyad dang*/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje chen po brgyad/ dur khrod kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro brgyad rnams gzugs dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas bros shing ma thul ba las/ 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs kyi thugs ka nas raṃ yig sbros nas/

byang shar u tsa la'i dur khrod kyi byang phyogs dug gi nags tshal chen po/ nag po brtsegs pa dang*/ ha la ha la la sogs pa dug gi rgyal po bzhi'i me tog kha sbyor du 'das pa'i dbus su thim pa las/ zhag bdun nas mon pa dug gi skyes bu zhes bya ba dpal ye shes kyi mgon po gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan trak+shad bdud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba gyur te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs kyis dregs pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad po de dag skad cig nyid la zhags pas drangs te bkugs/ bsdigs pa'i thabs sna tshogs kyis bsdigs nas phyag na rdo rje'i bka' lung bsgrags/ gnod sbyin rnams mdun 'gros dang*/ gshin rje rnams phyir 'brang dang*/ dur khrod ma mo rnams nus ma gsang ba'i yum du mdzad de bran du bkol bas/ chos skyong 'dis ma thul ba su yang med pa'o/ /zhes nag po gcer bu'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi las 'byung ngo*/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya seṅge'i bstan pa la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis grong khyer ser skyar 'dus pa chen po zhes bya bar lha klu gnod sbyin lha ma yin sogs sde brgyad kho na la zhag bdun du chos bstan nas/ 'byung po thams cad 'dus pa'i skabs der 'khor tshogs gzhan thams cad 'dus zin pa'i rjes su nag po sde po che zhes mtshan gsol ba dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'dis 'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs chen po dang phyag bsdebs pa sogs kyis rnam 'gyur bstan pas 'khor tshogs rnams skrag te/ 'di nyid ci yin zhes zhus pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pas 'di ni mthu bo che thams cad kyi gtso bo yin/ zhes lung bstan zhing chos gsungs pas/ bden par gzigs pa 'dus pa chen po mdo nyid nas bshad/ phyis bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po mtha' dag sprul nas lha chen po thams cad la dbang bskur ba'i tshe dpal mgon po 'di nyid la gsang mtshan rdo rje 'jigs byed zhes bya bar btags shing*/

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos so/ / de nas phyis rgya gar rdo rje gdan du 'khyams phyi ma klu sgrubs kyis bzhengs pa'i skabs su/ nag po chen po 'di'i lha khang chung ngu zhig mdzad/ rab gnas mdzad pa po yang bram ze mchog srid yin par grags/ mgon khang de seng ga gling pa'i dge slong rnams kyis bdag po byed pas chos skyong 'di la yang seṅga'i gling pa'i mgon po rta bzhon mar grags/ ༈ bod yul 'dir bstan pa'i srol kha btod pa'i thog ma sprul pa'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos ra sa 'phrul snang nyid kyis yang srung mar bskos pa yin/ sku 'dra phyis bzhengs pa yin kyang 'phrul snang gi sgo khang na mgon po trak+shad kyis mgon khang chen po yod pa yang sngon srung mar bskos pa'i 'brel chags la brten nas bzhengs par 'dug /khyad par du yang bsgom gnas yer ba'i brag la mgon po 'di bzhugs pa chos rgyal nyid kyis gzigs pas de dang mthun par rgya nag gi ha shang mahā de bas yer bar mgon po'i mchod pa rtag tu mdzad cing yer ba'i brag lha mgon por mtshan gsol/ rgya nag gi yul du 'og tu shan zer ba'i gtsug lag khang mi ma yin dang mi rdzu 'phrul can gyis bzhengs par grags pa de'i gnas bdag kyang chos skyong 'di yin pas dpe rnying pa rnams na/ rgya nag 'go hu de shan yul nas spyan 'dren no/ / zhes 'byung dus der li yul nas kyang mgon po 'di'i chos skor bod du byung bar grags/ de skabs skyid smad kyi brag ngo zhig la/ dpal mgon po trak+shad rkang thang ma'i sku brnyan gsal bar byon de'i thad kyi chu dang byang ngos kyi ri la me 'bar ba sogs cho 'phrul chen po byung bas de la chos rgyal nyid kyis zhal khebs kyi tshul du brag gcig 'gebs par mdzad skad/ de rjes chos rgyal khri srong sde btsan gyi dus slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mgon po 'di'i sgrub thabs mang po gter du sbas shing dngos su yang gsungs/

sngags 'chang ngharma gir tis kyang mang du bshad pa'i rgyun da lta ljang nag khros pa'i rgyud du grags pa tshogs bdag mgon po'i skor 'di rnams yin par snang*/ chos 'khor bsam yas kyi spyi'i bka' srung kyang dpal mgon bing ma la gtad ces grags pa'i bing ma ni gzungs kyi mgon por grags pa 'di yin zhing*/ phyag na mdung dang bing bsnams pa rta nag la chibs pa zhig yod/ bing ma gsung gi sgrub pa ru grags pa de ma yin/ mgon po 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs de lags/ gsang sngags rnying ma la gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mgon po 'di'i rgyud mda' nag ral pa can gyis rgyud sogs gter nas spyan drangs ba rgyud chung bdun yod pa gnubs lugs yin/ slob dpon shin+taṃ gar+bhas gsungs pa rnams da lta dwags po lugs kyi chos skor kyi nang na yod pa mgon po zhal dmar du grags pa'ang 'di nyid yin no/ / bstan pa phyir dar la dang po nyid du lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos mgon po trak+shad spru gri me dpal gyi rgyud du grags pa rnams kha che'i ngharma shrī la gsan zhing bsgyur/ de rjes jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas spyir mgon po'i chos skor rigs mi gcig pa mang du gsungs/ khyad par mgon po seng bzhon gyi skor yang mang du gsungs shing*/ phyag dar ba bstan pa rin chen la gnang bas 'grub par yang grags/ de la gra glu khu kha ches zhus/ bu do pa'i bstan srung mdzad/ de la bshes gnyen shar ba ra pas zhus/ bshes gnyen 'chad kha bas 'di zhus te shar ba ra ba'i chos grwa'i srung ma mdzad cing*/ phyis 'chad kha rnying ba btags/ dbu ru stod phyogs kyi bka' gdams pa'i gnas gzhi thams cad mgon po 'dis skyong ba shin tu mang ngo*/ / ༈ yang mgon po trak+shad dwags po lugs su grags pa ni/ slob dpon shan+ti gar+bha nas brgyud pa'i rnying ma yang rgya lcags zhing ba la bzhugs/ gsar ma jo bo rjes rong pa 'gar dge wal ba lcags ri ba de la rgya lcags zhing bas gsan

no/ /de'i drung du rje dwags po'i mtshan nyid sgam po chen pos gsan/ dang po mgon po'i gdams ngag rnams ma zhus/ phyi sgom par bzhugs/ 'phrin las dar ba'i dus su dkyer stod smad kyi mi rtsub po mang pos sdig pa bsags pa'i tshe/ bla ma lcag zhing ba la thog mar zhu ru btang ba'i skor las dmar chung mar grags pa dang*/ phyis mgon po nyid kyis lung bstan te slar yang zhur btang ba la thang sham mar grags pa'i gdams pa'i skor rnams byung*/ phyis gdams ngag la 'dra min mang po byung nas sun phyung ba'i bar du dpe 'thebs gcig mdzad nas ka la dung mtshor gter du sbas/ de phyis skyes bu ye shes rdo rje'i skye ba dung mtshor ras pas gter nas byung ba'i dwags po'i lugs la yang bka' gter gnyis su grags/ yang shod bu lo tsā ba'i lugs la ye shes kyi mgon po trak+shad nyid phyag na gri khug thod pa 'dzin pa chibs med pa gtso bo ye shes mgon po'i tshul du mdzad/ rta nag la chibs pa las mkhan du sbyar ba'i lcam dral gnyis 'phrin las kyi mgon po dang gsum 'khor dur khrod ma mo bdun dang bcas pa gcig 'byung*/ de la shog bu'i mgon po grags yang slob dpon ngha na saṃskri tas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi lugs la gtso bo zhal gcig shā na'i zhal/ 'khor yang shā na mo bdun kho nas bskor ba gcig yod/ 'di ni bla ma skye lo tsā ba ye shes kyi mgon po 'di nyid chos skyong du mdzad pa'i skyo mgon du grags/ lo tsā ba chen po 'gos lhas btsas kyis kyang*/ dang po rgya gar la ma byon gong nyid nas mgon po 'di 'grub pas nus mthu che bar yod/ rgya gar la byon dus lam du gtsang po'i yul du jag pa tshan che ba gcig gis chom por yong ba la zhi ba'i ser sbyangs mang po mdzad cing*/ khyad par du nga rgya gar du chos slob tu 'gro zhing sangs rgyas bstan pa'i phyir yin byas kyang ma nyan pa la/ chos skyong dpang por bzhag

/sde brgyad thams cad la dmod bcol drag po mdzad cing na bza' brdabs pas de ma thag ngag dpon rta khar las lhung zhing khrag skyugs te shi/ gzhan thams cad bros so/ / phyis nag po gcer bu'i rgyud chung ba le'u bcu gsum ma yang 'gos kyis bsgyur bar bshad/ de rjes chos skaur 'di la lho rgyud byang rgyud gnyis sogs sna tshogs su byung kyang 'phan yul nyan por byung ba'i grub thob 'tshod chen po nas chos skyong du mdzad pas 'tshod mgon du grags/ de la dri bo rgyal yon gyis zhus/ de la mkhas pa dri mgon gyis zhus/ de la gong po pa dar shes kyis zhus nas da lta'i bar du ma chad tsam yod/ 'di mgon po gtso bo zhabs thang lcam dral las mkhan rta bzhon 'khor ma mo bdun shwa na bdun khyi zhal du med par shwa na rang gzugs su yang*/ yang mgon po trak+shad ma ning mar grags pa ni gsang sngags rnying ma'i dpal mgon ma ning dang phal cher mthun la 'di la brgyud pa'i rim pa gsum ste/ dang po slob dpon pad+mas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni nag po shan ti bha dra yang zer/ dam tshig rdo rje chung ba yang zer ba don la rje mar pa'i bla ma thar pa'i lam ston yang 'di ka yin/ 'gos lo dang nag tsho ba'i yang bla mar gyur pa mtshan bod skad zhi ba bzang po bla dwags la rgya gar nag po chen po zer ba 'dis bod du gnang ba yin zhing mgul lugs lcags can du grags/ gsum pa ni/ bla ma rgya gar nag chung du grags pa dam pa sangs rgyas kyis 'di'i sgrub thabs gsungs nas zhu lo tsā ba la bshad pas zhu'i mgon por yang grags zer dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gsungs nas kyang mgon po'i 'di'i tshod byas na sgrub thabs gzhan 'di rnams mgon 'dra tsam yin gsungs skad/ de dag mtshon pa ste lugs mi gcig pa mang du byung*/ de thams cad kyi nang nas chos skor rgyas shing bka' babs kyi byin rlabs dang 'phrin las dpag tu med pa ni dpal ye shes kyi mgon po gnyos lugs 'di yin/

de la gnyos pa rnams dang po gsang sngags rnying ma sgyu 'phrul gtso bor mdzad cing*/ chos skyong lha mo srog sgrub lcags phur can la byed pa yin/ gnyos lo tsā ba'i yab dang khu bo gnyos mthu rgyal dang gnyos spang la me shor gyi dus la sngar gyi rnying ma'i steng du gsar ma'i yo ga la mkhas par byung*/ mthu rgyal gyi sras gnyon lo tsā ba yon tan grags yin/ 'khrungs sa dang 'phrin las mdzad sa ni gtso bor kha rag rtsa ru byung*/ chung ngu'i dus nas yab chos rnams mkhas par mkhyen/ mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan dang rkyang po chos blo la gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs sman pa'i zhabs kyi 'grel pa sogs gsan nas rags rims tsam mkhyen pa'i skabs lo tsā slob par thegs te/ bal po spyi ther pa rnam rgyal dbang po de nyid lo gnyis bsten/ de nas rgya gar bi kra ma la shi lar byon/ bod nas der byon pa'i bar la lho brag mar pas phyag g.yog mdzad/ de nas bla mas so sor chos zhu gsungs nas mar pa la chos rgyag gnang sbyin bzang bar mdzad nas so sor gyes/ slob dpon pa ling ar+ya tsar+ya mtshan dngos de ba shra ngha ste lha la dad pa zer/ bla ma de la thog ma nyid nas gser srang brgyad cu gya bzhi dus gcig tu phul/ gsang 'dus dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ye shes zhabs lugs su grags pa lta bu rgyud zab la byin rlabs dang gzi byin che ba zhig yongs su rdzogs par zhus/ las tshogs cha tshang ba ston pa'i chos skor zhig kyang zhus/ bdag gi bstod pa la 'go gcig na yod/ bod kyi mi rnams phrag dog dang gdug rtsub che bas chos skyong mthu che la myur ba zhu zhes zhu ba gsum mdzad/ dang po gnyis la gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs dang gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gnang*/ phyi ma la ngas bi kra ma la shi la'i bstan pa bsrung dgos pas mgon po'i rigs brgya dang drug cu'i sgrub thabs 'phrin las gtor chog las tshogs kun shes kyang thams cad kyi nang nas zab cing byin rlabs che ba myur la tshan che ba gcig yod pa 'di ster zhes gsungs pas/

mgon po'i dbang nangs par gnang rgyu'i do nub lo tsā ba rang gi mnal lam du mi nag po gser gyi ske rags bcings pa zhig byung nas bla ma khyod dang sbrags te bod du gtong bar 'dug gsung*/ de ni mgon po trak+shad shin tu 'go ba'i ltas yin par 'dug

/de ltar bi kra ma la shi lar gzhi mdzad de rgya gar ma ga ngha dang bha ga la kun tu lo skor tsam bzhugs/ bla mas lung bstan pa la khyod rang gi yul mnga' skam pa 'dra ba/ bar yogs 'dra ba/ phug slang 'dra ba zhig na brag dmar nag la phug pa byang shar du lta ba zhig 'dug /der sgrub pa byas na myur du zhal ston pa 'dug gsung*/ lo tsā bas kyang rang yul du phebs pas gnas de ka btsal ba'i bya dkar zhes bya ba'i lung pa'i phug na 'dug pas der sgrub pa mdzad/ zla ba drug nas gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes te mgon po bka' nyan du sgrub pa'i sgrub chen zhag bdun mdzad pas mgon po'i zhal gzigs shing bran du 'khor ba'i rtags rnams byung*/ rje mar pas kyang dang po chos rgyag gnang ba'i sku drin bsabs thabs su rje nā ro pa'i thugs dam bde mchog gi rdo sku sogs ngo mtshar ba'i byin rlabs rten 'ga' shas phyag tu phul 'dug /gzhan bod nyid du pan+ḍi ta zla ba mgon po dang gha ya ngha ra sogs bsten nas gsang sngags kyi sngags rgyud mang po mkhyen par mdzad/ gsang 'dus dang gshin rje gshed skor gsum ste/ pha rgyud sde bzhi la bshad sgrub kyi grwa chen po'i rkang btsugs/ bde dgyes ma ya sogs ma rgyud kyang mang du gsungs/ mthu stobs thogs pa med pa mnga'/ sku tshe smad kyi dus shig na kha rag thod bur gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa zhig mdzad dus mnal lam du/ la chen po gcig la tshong pa shin tu tshan che ba gsum snga phyir rim can du sgrol 'don lan gsum du mdzad cing de rjes tshad bzhi pa de la klung thams cad gang pa tsam gyi 'grul ba'i sgrol 'don mdzad cing de nas kyang bar ma chad par mi mang po la de la sgrol bar rmis/ nga yi phyis su rgyud pa gsum du 'gro don chen po cha mnyam pa yong ba 'dug /bzhi pa de thams cad las phul du byung ba'i 'gro don mtha' yas pa zhig yong bar 'dug /de dag gi rjes su yang rang gzhan la phan thogs pa'i 'phrin las can mang du byung bar 'dug ces lung bstan to/

/ gter ma'i lo rgyus ni/ gnyos lo chen po dang spyil rab dga' gnyis kyis don sbyod gcig la dbang bskur stong zha lha khang du bzhugs pa'i tshe zhā'i mgon po gri thod can zhes pa'i mgon khang yod/ der zhag bdun bzhugs pas nub re bzhin cho 'phrul shin tu che ba byung*/ bdun pa'i nub mgon po sku brnyan gyis gsung 'byon te/ nga'i pus mo'i thad ka'i bar phyogs kyi gyang la sgrub thabs kyi dpe yod pas longs shig gsung*/ nangs par gyang rkos pas slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs cha lag dang bcas pa byung*/ sngar gyi gter ma dang gnad gcig par dgongs/ bka' gter gcig tu dril nas nyams len mdzad/ sngar gyi lung bstan dang mthun par sras rdo rje bla ma dang dpal seng dang grags pa dpal te bla rabs gsum po de la'ang dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi grwa ba mang po 'dus 'phrin las cher byung*/ bzhi pa rgyal ba lha nang pa sangs rgyas ras chen mtshan dngos chos kyi gzi brjid de 'di yi rje 'bri gung ba'i slob ma'i gtso bo mthar thug mdzad/ gnas gsum du grags pa'i gnas sgo phyes 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam/ dgon gnas lha rin chen mthil rang du yang 'dag sbyar ba stong brgyad brgya tsam rgyun tu byung*/ de'i dbon po lha rin chen dbang gi rgyal pos gter ston chos rgyal rin chen gling pas gter nas sbyan drangs pa'i mgon po 'di'i chos skor gnam lcags spu grir grags pa dang*/ gter ston rgya grags pa 'od zer gyis chos skyong 'di'i g.yul bzlog gi skor rnams spyan drangs pa'i gter nas bton pa de gnyis rang la gsan te phyag len du 'debs par mdzad pa yin/ sangs rgyas ras chen gyi ring la ro 'bri mtshams phyogs su dar rgyas che bar byung*/ par ri slo phug sdeng chen la sogs pa'i chos grwa rnams kyi bsrung mar mdzad/ de rjes kun mkhyen saṅga bha dras gnas bzhi de dag las brgyud pa dang*/

lha bsod rgyal po'i drung du gnyos lugs kyi chos skor mtha' dag gsan/ mgon po bran bzhin du 'khol/ rin chen sgang gi mgon po mgon po'i bris skus sku gnyer la gsung byon te rgyal pa lha nang pa'i skye ba yin par lung bstan/ dbus pa chu shod gyi dmag 'khrugs nas grags pa sangs rgyas dpal rin gyis dgon par dmag yong bas 'bri mtshams thams cad bcom dus kyang dmag dpon gcig gis dgon pa mthong ma thag khrag skyug cing brgyal pa dang*/ dmag mi rnams smyos pa 'bog pa sogs cho 'phrul chen po byung bas/ dbus pa'i dmag dpon thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs/ ting nge 'dzin dang nus mthu dpag tu med pa mnga'/ 'di'i chos skor gnyos kyi gdung brgyud bar ma chad pa'i rim pa byin rlabs kyi bka' babs dang ldan pa lha bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi drung du rje grol mchog gi gsan/ sku'i skye ba rim pa gsum gyi chos skyong du gyur pas bzhed dgos kyi 'phrin las thams cad mgon po 'dis sgrub pa yin pa 'dug /yang kun mkhyen saṅga bha dra nas brgyud pa mkhas grub sangs rgyas bzang po dang kun spang gu ru chos rin/ byang sems bsod rin/ sems dpa' bsod nams rgyal mtshan rnams la brgyud/ rje grol mchog dang sems dpa' bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis la rje rdo ring pa phyi mas gsan/ chos skyong 'dis 'phrin las sgrub pa zhig yin par 'dug /de'i drung du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' snying pos gsan no/ /de ltar na dpal mgon trak+shad kyi chos skor lo rgyus 'di ni rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung bzhin kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mos zin bris su bkod pa'i dge ba'i mthu stobs kyis/ bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/
